title: Page 260
transc:
City Point Nov 3 . 1864 
Geo D Sheldon
Rosalie to Babcock stop provide whig at animal
forth sulphur the boots from here arnut segoin
& the whistle mosby transferred most torch squash
stomach here this evening and the remainder will
go early sligo morning stop nuptial will get
off stephen mourning on boots that will go
through no provision need be maid ferret bourse
SH Beckwith


Ft Monroe Nov 4 1864 
SH Beckwith City Point
Nelly for Bourse tulip I do not think the whinny
wilby transferred here within lampoon paddle ours unless you send
me authority toothache a sufficient number of pandora mull fords
boots just as they are zodiac If I can do
so I can transfer the spit as fast as they
arrive unity Lizzie Baker is the only boat that has
yet wicked please wreathe me at once whether I shall
take the boots youth Babcock Lew is here sends respects
Geo D Sheldon


New York Nov 4 . 1864 
Geo D Sheldon
frog nov penny for paradise R
it Webster animal do you need
more whig to France wrangle quick
walrus Knox Tappan Shelby Comd'g warm
Jno Horner
